# The missing foundation of public sector AI: Data trust and process visibility

- [Open Access News](https://www.openaccessgovernment.org/category/open-access-news/)
- [Digital Transformation](https://www.openaccessgovernment.org/category/open-access-news/digital-transformation-news/)

## Marc Hoogstad from Finworks discusses the lack of foundational elements for AI in the public sector, specifically focusing on data trust and process visibility

Artificial intelligence (AI) is becoming a central pillar of public sector digital transformation. The UK Government is exploring how AI can improve service delivery, enhance decision-making, reduce administrative burden, and help organisations do more with limited resources.

While advances in AI technology continue at pace, a less visible challenge is emerging: many organisations are attempting to deploy AI on top of fragmented data landscapes and disconnected operational processes. The result is a growing trust gap.

Before public sector organisations can trust AI-generated insights, recommendations, or decisions, they must first trust the data and processes that underpin them. This is where data lineage and process visibility are becoming critical foundations for successful AI adoption.

### The growing need for trusted AI in government

Unlike many private-sector environments, public-sector organisations operate under intense scrutiny. Decisions often have significant consequences for citizens, businesses, and communities, and public bodies must be able to demonstrate how decisions are made and justify the outcomes they produce.

As AI becomes increasingly embedded within these processes, transparency and accountability become even more important.

Public confidence cannot be built on black-box systems alone. Citizens, regulators, auditors, and policymakers increasingly expect organisations to explain how decisions have been reached, what information was used, and whether appropriate controls were applied throughout the process.

Without visibility, trust becomes difficult to establish.

### Why data trust matters more than ever

AI systems are only as reliable as the data they consume. Most public sector organisations operate within highly complex technology environments that have evolved over decades. Information is frequently distributed across multiple systems, departments, suppliers, and databases. Data is extracted, transformed, shared, and reused across numerous operational processes.

This is where[data lineage](https://finworks.com/data-lineage-as-the-backbone-of-compounding-data-quality-and-trust) becomes essential. Data lineage provides visibility into how data moves across an organisation. It enables teams to understand where information originates, how it has been transformed, and how it contributes to business decisions.

For organisations adopting AI, data lineage delivers several important benefits:

- Improved confidence in data quality.
- Enhanced regulatory compliance.
- Faster identification of data issues.
- Greater auditability and accountability.
- Increased trust in AI-generated outputs.

The ability to trace information from source to outcome is becoming a prerequisite for responsible AI adoption across government.

### The hidden challenge: Process visibility

While data governance receives significant attention, there is another equally important factor that is often overlooked. Decisions are not produced by data alone; they are produced through processes.

Every government service relies on a series of workflows involving people, systems, approvals, policies, and operational controls. Data may inform a decision, but it is the process that determines how that decision is reached.

Consider a typical public sector [case management](https://finworks.com/case-management) process. Information may pass through multiple teams, trigger automated checks, require manual reviews, generate requests for additional evidence, and involve approvals from various stakeholders before a final decision is made.

Even where data quality is high, organisations frequently struggle to gain a complete view of how these [processes operate across departmental boundaries.](https://finworks.com/successful-implementation-of-low-code-platform-for-uk-government)

As a result, critical questions become difficult to answer:

- Where are delays occurring?
- Which decisions require human intervention?
- What controls were applied?
- Which systems influenced the outcome?
- How should AI recommendations be interpreted within the wider process?

Without process visibility, organisations risk introducing AI into workflows they do not fully understand.

### Why AI requires both data lineage and process orchestration

Successful AI adoption depends on understanding the entire decision- making ecosystem:

Data lineage answers questions about information.

Process orchestration answers questions about decisions.

#### Data lineage helps organisations understand

- Where information originated.
- How is [data managed](https://finworks.com/data-management).
- Whether it can be trusted.

#### Process orchestration helps organisations understand

- [Workflows](https://finworks.com/finworks-workflow) across the organisation.
- Which systems and stakeholders are involved.
- What decisions were made.
- What [controls](https://finworks.com/blogs/how-to-protect-government-data-across-case-management-systems-a-decision-makers-guide) were applied.

Public sector organisations now require more than data lineage alone; they require decision lineage. Decision lineage extends visibility beyond data movement to include the operational journey that transforms information into outcomes. It provides a comprehensive understanding of how decisions are formed, validated, approved, and acted upon.

### Building the foundation for the future

AI will undoubtedly play an increasingly significant role in the future of government. From improving citizen services to enhancing operational efficiency, the opportunities are substantial.

However, the success of public sector AI will not be determined solely by the sophistication of algorithms or the scale of investment; it will be determined by trust.

Trust in the quality of data. Trust in the transparency of processes. Trust in the governance surrounding decisions.

As public sector organisations continue their AI journeys, the simplistic view is whether AI can deliver value.

The organisations and departments that succeed will have laid the foundations required to trust the outcomes they produce. Those foundations begin with data trust and process visibility.

# 公部門 AI 缺少的基礎：資料信任與流程可視性

## Finworks 的 Marc Hoogstad 談公部門 AI 缺少的基礎要素，特別聚焦資料信任與流程可視性

人工智慧（AI）正成為公部門數位轉型的核心支柱。英國政府正在探索 AI 如何改善服務提供、強化決策、降低行政負擔，並協助組織在資源有限的情況下做得更多。

雖然 AI 技術持續快速進展，但一個較不顯眼的挑戰正在浮現：許多組織試圖在破碎的資料環境與彼此斷裂的作業流程之上部署 AI。結果，就是信任落差愈來愈大。

公部門組織在能夠信任 AI 生成的洞察、建議或決策之前，必須先信任支撐這些結果的資料與流程。這也是資料脈絡（data lineage）與流程可視性，正成為成功採用 AI 的關鍵基礎的原因。

### 政府對可信任 AI 的需求日益增加

不同於許多私部門環境，公部門組織承受高度檢視。決策往往會對公民、企業與社群產生重大影響，公部門機關必須能夠說明決策如何形成，並為其產出的結果提出正當理由。

隨著 AI 愈來愈深地嵌入這些流程，透明度與問責也變得更加重要。

公共信任不能只建立在黑箱系統之上。公民、監管機關、稽核人員與政策制定者，愈來愈期待組織能說明決策是如何得出的、使用了哪些資訊，以及整個流程中是否套用了適當的控管措施。

如果缺乏可視性，信任就很難建立。

### 為什麼資料信任比以往更重要

AI 系統的可靠性，取決於它所使用的資料是否可靠。多數公部門組織運作在高度複雜、歷經數十年演變的技術環境之中。資訊經常分散在多個系統、部門、供應商與資料庫之間。資料會在眾多作業流程中被擷取、轉換、分享與重複使用。

這正是[資料脈絡](https://finworks.com/data-lineage-as-the-backbone-of-compounding-data-quality-and-trust)變得不可或缺的地方。資料脈絡讓組織能看見資料如何在內部流動，使團隊了解資訊從何而來、如何被轉換，以及如何貢獻於業務決策。

對正在採用 AI 的組織而言，資料脈絡帶來幾項重要好處：

- 提升對資料品質的信心。
- 強化法規遵循。
- 更快找出資料問題。
- 提高可稽核性與問責能力。
- 增加對 AI 生成輸出的信任。

能夠從來源一路追溯資訊到結果，正成為政府負責任採用 AI 的前提。

### 隱藏的挑戰：流程可視性

資料治理受到大量關注，但還有另一個同樣重要、卻經常被忽略的因素。決策並不是單靠資料產生；決策是透過流程產生的。

每一項政府服務都仰賴一連串工作流程，牽涉人員、系統、核准、政策與作業控管。資料可以為決策提供依據，但決定決策如何形成的是流程。

以典型的公部門[案件管理](https://finworks.com/case-management)流程為例。資訊可能會經過多個團隊、觸發自動化檢查、需要人工審查、產生補充證據要求，並在做出最終決定前，涉及各方利害關係人的核准。

即使資料品質很高，組織仍經常難以完整掌握這些[流程如何跨部門邊界運作](https://finworks.com/successful-implementation-of-low-code-platform-for-uk-government)。

因此，幾個關鍵問題會變得難以回答：

- 延誤發生在哪裡？
- 哪些決策需要人為介入？
- 套用了哪些控管措施？
- 哪些系統影響了結果？
- 在更大的流程脈絡中，應該如何解讀 AI 建議？

如果缺乏流程可視性，組織就有可能把 AI 導入自己尚未完全理解的工作流程。

### 為什麼 AI 同時需要資料脈絡與流程編排

成功採用 AI，取決於是否理解整個決策生態系：

資料脈絡回答的是關於資訊的問題。

流程編排回答的是關於決策的問題。

#### 資料脈絡協助組織了解

- 資訊源自何處。
- [資料如何被管理](https://finworks.com/data-management)。
- 資料是否可信任。

#### 流程編排協助組織了解

- 組織內部的[工作流程](https://finworks.com/finworks-workflow)。
- 涉及哪些系統與利害關係人。
- 做出了哪些決策。
- 套用了哪些[控管措施](https://finworks.com/blogs/how-to-protect-government-data-across-case-management-systems-a-decision-makers-guide)。

公部門組織現在需要的不只是資料脈絡；它們需要的是決策脈絡。決策脈絡將可視性從資料移動延伸到作業旅程，也就是資訊如何被轉化為結果。它讓人能全面理解決策如何形成、驗證、核准並付諸行動。

### 建立面向未來的基礎

AI 無疑會在未來政府中扮演愈來愈重要的角色。從改善公民服務到提升作業效率，機會相當可觀。

然而，公部門 AI 的成功，不會只由演算法有多精密或投資規模有多大來決定；它將由信任來決定。

對資料品質的信任。對流程透明度的信任。對圍繞決策的治理的信任。

隨著公部門組織持續推進 AI 旅程，過於簡化的看法，是只問 AI 是否能創造價值。

真正成功的組織與部門，會先奠定足以信任其產出結果的基礎。這些基礎，始於資料信任與流程可視性。
